title: Retirement Longevity Calculator
equation: available_t = B_(t-1)*(1+r_t) for an explicitly selected end-period profile; paid_t=min(available_t,W_t); B_t=available_t-paid_t. exactZeroPeriod=min{t:B_t=0}; firstShortfallPeriod=min{t:available_t<W_t}. Report separately, or null within H.
definitions: Keep exact-zero and first-shortfall distinct; neither is silently selected as the longevity meaning.
Finite H>=1; nonnegative available balances and scheduled withdrawals; per-period rates > -1. Beginning-period timing requires its own recurrence.
Final partial payment versus stop-before-payment, withdrawal growth, inflation, benefits and taxes still require policy selection.
questions: Which named output defines longevity: first exact-zero closing balance, first scheduled-payment shortfall, or both?
Which timing, partial-final-payment and horizon rules are approved?
evidence: Existing finance/swp.ts v1 stops on exact zero. Independent 200/100/0 witness gives exact zero at 2, first shortfall at 3; no historical output edit.

title: 401(k) Calculator
equation: Maintain total asset buckets E(employee-owned) and U(employer-origin), each including its attributable returns and approved fees/flows. Total=E+U; vested=E+v_t*U only for a uniform approved vesting fraction v_t. Tranche-specific schedules require separate U_j and sum(v_jt*U_j).
definitions: Record full employer contributions in total assets; vesting changes ownership entitlement, not whether assets exist.
Employee-owned and employer-origin buckets must follow approved timing, fee, withdrawal, forfeiture and vesting rules; do not apply a new vesting fraction to employee assets.
Vested balance is not necessarily currently accessible or penalty-free. Eligibility, statutory limits, tax year, match/true-up rules remain unresolved.
questions: Approve total and vested outputs separately, contribution timing and tranche vesting schedules?
Which plan/year contribution limits, forfeiture and distribution restrictions apply?
evidence: Bookkeeping witness E=1000, U=100, v=.5: total1100, vested1050. A later vesting change to1 makes vested1100 without a new100 employer asset.

title: Customer Lifetime Value Calculator
definitions: Finite integer N>=0; p_t in[0,1]; d>-1 per matching period; end-period cash flows; all money one explicit currency/basis.
R_t and C_active_t are conditional on activity; C_unconditional_t is an expected unconditional cohort-per-customer cost, not survival-weighted again.
Unconditional costs are still time-discounted. CAC is t0 exactly once and excluded from all recurring costs.
No steady-state/churn conversion or retention distribution is selected.
questions: Which finite horizon, cohort and activity probabilities apply?
Which costs are conditional, unconditional or t0 acquisition, and what discount convention is approved?
evidence: p=.5,R=100,C_unconditional=20,d=0:30, not40; d=.1 yields300/11, not400/11. N=0 yields -CAC.

title: Marketplace Fee Calculator
definitions: G is gross receipts before refunds R; F is gross assessed fees before separate eligible fee credits K.
Choose a single gross or net convention; net receipts/fees cannot be debited/credited again. Each component appears once.
Platform, country, currency, account tier, schedule/effective date and fee-specific eligible bases remain unselected; Etsy evidence cannot establish a universal marketplace policy.
questions: Which marketplace and effective schedule are selected?
Which refund/credit events and gross/net inputs are supplied versus derived by each rule?
evidence: G100,F12,R20,K2,goods40:30; equivalent net receipts80 and net fees10 also give30 without an extra refund or credit.

title: Etsy Profit Calculator
definitions: G before refunds; each F before eligible credits K; all inputs disjoint and in one reporting currency.
Seller-funded versus platform-covered refunds must be separately identified; do not automatically debit seller receipts for a platform-funded refund.
No rates or refund entitlements selected. Fee types have separately sourced shipping/tax/discount/currency bases; credits never assumed universal.
questions: Which Etsy seller country, currency, effective fee revision and refund funding apply?
Approve each fee base and credit entitlement, and gross/net input convention?
evidence: Seller-funded R20 with G100,F12,goods40,K0 gives28 versus48 when the refund is omitted; credits require separate eligibility evidence.

title: Return Rate Impact Calculator
definitions: N integer>=0, q in[0,1], consistent cohort and recognition period.
C_sale contains initial per-sale costs exactly once, including original processing fees if applicable. A retained original fee is not a new incremental return charge.
F_incremental contains only additional return-specific charges not in C_sale or H_incremental. Fee reversals are explicit signed adjustments, never invented.
V_recovered is separately valued inventory recovery, not cash revenue; gross recovery less separate H or net recovery without repeating the same costs. Accounting compliance remains unasserted.
questions: Approve the sale/return cost boundary and separate cash versus inventory reporting?
Which recovery valuation, refund/fee events and recognition period apply?
evidence: N100,P50,C_sale33 including fee3,q=.1,R50,H5,V20,F_incremental0 gives1350. Repeating retained fee3 yields1320 and is excluded.

title: Golf Handicap Calculator
equation: Provisional dependency proposal only: source-approved eligible score differentials -> applicable differential-level adjustments -> source-defined record window/selection -> average -> source-defined rounding, caps and any remaining committee/index adjustments. For a verified eligible 20-record branch only, candidate selection is lowest8 of most recent20.
definitions: A single 18-hole differential 113/slope*(adjustedGrossScore-courseRating-PCC) is not a Handicap Index.

Do not label this a complete or verified WHS2024 algorithm. Full adopted authority, revision, eligibility, short record sets, 9-hole handling, exceptional-score rules, cap eligibility, rounding and committee powers remain unverified.

Upstream live R&A report suggests differential adjustments precede selection; its date/revision is unpinned and full USGA2024 text was blocked. Exact round/cap/order must be confirmed from complete version-bound rules.
Synthetic selective-adjustment witness establishes noncommutativity only; it does not authorize an adjustment magnitude or policy.
questions: Provide the complete adopted authority/revision and approve the full dependency/order for differentials, selection, rounding, caps and committee action?
Which eligible-round, short-history, 9-hole and exceptional-score branches are required?
evidence: Synthetic20 scores1..20 with ninth score changed9->0: selecting adjusted lowest8 gives3.5; selecting original8 before adjustment gives4.5. Not a normative golf fixture.
